reference.question: Solve \(2x^2-3x-2=0\) using the quadratic formula. (Separate the two roots with a comma.)
reference.solution:
Method 1: Use the quadratic formula

\(a=2\), \(b=-3\), \(c=-2\), and \(b^2-4ac=9+16=25\). Thus, \(x=(3\pm5)/4\), so \(x=2\) or \(x=-1/2\).
